title: Browser test workflow target
description: Where the app under test lives. Every target is offline or on loopback; remote hosts are never contacted.

choices.label: Static folder with index.html — served on 127.0.0.1 by the run
Prototype package — its built offline HTML (prototype.manifest.json)
Loopback URL — an app you already serve, such as npm start on 127.0.0.1:4173

fields.label: Project-relative folder with index.html
fields.help: For example tests/fixtures/workflows/sign-up. Only files inside the folder are served.

fields.label: Prototype package folder
fields.help: For example prototypes/my-prototype, as prepared by node bin/app prototype --out prototypes/my-prototype.

fields.label: Loopback URL with port
fields.help: For example http://127.0.0.1:4173/. Only 127.0.0.1, localhost and [::1] are accepted.
